edges.reason: receive() gates ETH senders by comparing msg.sender to a hard-coded router address.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender when updating allowance.
internal _transfer derives the from address from the external caller.
_mint() is public and restricted by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender with _owner.
excludeFromReward() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
includeInReward() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
excludeFromFee() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
includeInFee() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
setDevelopmentWalletWallet() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
setDonationWalletWallet() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
setMaxTxPercent() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
setBuyBackEnabled() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
transferOwnership() onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp directly as the Uniswap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp directly as the Uniswap deadline.
swapETHForTokens computes the deadline as block.timestamp.add(300).
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() updates the allowance through the internal _approve path.
_transfer forwards the actual token movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer performs the Uniswap liquidity swap through external calls before the token state changes.
_transfer triggers the ETH buyback external swap before final state updates.
_transfer stores balanceOf(address(this)) in contractTokenBalance.
_transfer derives overMinTokenBalance from contractTokenBalance.
_transfer reads address(this).balance into the local balance variable.
_transfer uses uniswapV2Router while performing swaps.
_transfer compares the from address against uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer checks the inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy lock.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
_tokenTransfer routes standard transfers to _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer routes transfers to excluded recipients to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer routes transfers from excluded senders to _transferFromExcluded.
_tokenTransfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the transfer limit.
_tokenTransfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee handling.
_tokenTransfer computes burnAmt from _burnFee.
_tokenTransfer computes fundingAmt from _fundingFee.
_tokenTransfer sends funding tokens to DevelopmentWalletAddress.
_tokenTransfer sends funding tokens to DonationWalletAddress.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds the resulting ETH and remaining tokens as liquidity.
swapAndLiquify halves the token balance into half.
swapAndLiquify computes otherHalf from the token balance.
swapAndLiquify captures the contract ETH balance into initialBalance.
swapAndLiquify computes newBalance from the ETH balance delta.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
addLiquidity performs the external Uniswap addLiquidityETH call with ETH value.
buyBackTokens calls swapETHForTokens when the amount is positive.
swapETHForTokens performs the external Uniswap swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
_mint performs unchecked addition on the total supply state variable.
_mint increases _tTotal without overflow protection.
_mint increases _tOwned[owner()] without overflow protection.
_transferStandard computes reflection and token amounts through _getValues.
_transferStandard updates the reflection balance mapping.
_transferStandard reads/writes _tOwned for excluded accounts.
balanceOf converts reflection balances using tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads _rTotal to bound the reflection amount.
_getValues uses _taxFee for fee computation.
_getValues uses _liquidityFee for liquidity computation.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the reflection amount.
excludeFromReward marks the account as excluded in _isExcluded.
excludeFromReward pushes the account into the _excluded array.
includeInReward clears the account exclusion flag.
includeInReward removes the account from the _excluded array.
excludeFromFee sets the fee exemption flag to true.
includeInFee sets the fee exemption flag to false.
setDevelopmentWalletWallet writes DevelopmentWalletAddress.
setDonationWalletWallet writes DonationWalletAddress.
setMaxTxPercent writes _maxTxAmount.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
setBuyBackEnabled writes buyBackEnabled.
constructor assigns the entire _rTotal to the deployer.
constructor stores the Uniswap router reference.
constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair.
The Uniswap token-to-ETH swap sends ETH back to this contract and can re-enter the payable receive().
The Uniswap ETH swap transfers ETH which may re-enter the payable receive() function.
